selected_evidence.requirement: Web app runs as unprivileged appsvc account
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc user created (uid 1000); webapp.service cgroup and process tree run entirely under user-1000.slice; post-reboot ps shows conmon/container process owned by user appsvc
ss shows pasta listening on *:8080; curl to 127.0.0.1:8080 and $NODE_IP:8080 return HTTP 200 both pre- and post-reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot without an active login session for appsvc
selected_evidence.summary: loginctl linger=yes set for appsvc; loginctl list-sessions shows no sessions both before and after reboot, yet webapp.service is active immediately after boot (started at 10:53:23, right after boot at 10:53:20)

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node restart with changed boot identity proof
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged (connection dropped); post-reboot poll shows new boot_id 0fd74c0c-f63b-450b-a2e0-f82419c05c81, confirming an actual restart of node1

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service and data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, webapp.service is active and running (started right after boot), HTTP 200 confirmed on localhost and NODE_IP:8080, zero login sessions, linger still enabled, container process owned by appsvc
